Sec. 2 (preprint p. 3): Toromona is one of Girard's (1971) nomina nuda; 'the only linguistic data that exist on Toromona.. is a list of 97 words collected by.. Marius Del Castillo published in Del Castillo (1929: 122-123)'; Del Castillo said they spoke almost the same language as the Araona, 66% (64/97) of the words near-identical to Pitman's (1981) Araona dictionary (Guillaume 2011a). sources.note: No prose on phonology. The only Toromona data are seven glossed forms in the comparative table (p. 177): eye e-shásh, hand i-á, fire kuáti, house ekíi, tapir sháawi, maize shishé, two béka, printed with acute accents (é-, -á, -é) as in the neighbouring Cavina/Arasa/Tiatinagua columns. These are wordlist-only accent marks copied from Armentia 1887, not a stress statement.
